p02.title: The assistant drafts
p02.desc: The client's message goes to Cloudflare Workers AI; code checks every number it returns. The desk opens with one signature, no transaction.

p03.title: Read, then sign
p03.desc: The seller checks the exact values, then signs the invoice: a signature, not a transaction. No gas.

p04.title: Its PayPal twin
p04.desc: One PayPal sandbox invoice for the same amount, made and read back from PayPal.

p05.title: One link, two rails
p05.desc: The link goes to the client. On the till, the chain and PayPal are both watched.

p06.title: The client pays on PayPal
p06.desc: The pay page checks the invoice first, then opens PayPal's own sandbox page. A guest card payment, sandbox test card.

p07.title: Verified with PayPal
p07.desc: The till reads PayPal's own record of the invoice, at its exact amount, never a message.

p08.title: Close the other rail
p08.desc: Paid on PayPal, so the desk proposes cancelling the dollar link. The seller approves the exact values: one transaction.

p09.title: Or dollars on chain
p09.desc: A second invoice and its twin, paid in USDC from the client's wallet: one signature, one transaction.

p10.title: Recorded on PayPal
p10.desc: Check my invoices: the chain payment is recorded on the PayPal invoice, with Undo. PayPal now shows it paid.

p11.title: Was I really paid?
p11.desc: A pasted message is never proof: the verdict comes from PayPal and the chain.

p12.title: Every light, checked live
p12.desc: The status page reads the network, the contract, PayPal and the assistant.
